integrity: Self-contained symbolic argument; standalone exhaustive finite checker confirms selected sizes. The numerical checks are not an infinite proof or external validation; possible unindexed equivalent statements remain a bibliographic risk.
scientific_limitations: Fully occupied equal-part complete multipartite graphs, two agent colors, symmetric preference at one-half, open-neighborhood fractions, strictly bilateral profitable swaps. Three-part exact counting and random-color asymptotics. Not a theorem for unequal parts, closed neighborhoods, multicolor populations or arbitrary single-peaked functions.
title: Equilibrium hyperplanes and an exact census for balanced-neighbor swap games on complete multipartite networks
